concepts.def: 'Our Common Future' defined sustainable development meeting present needs without compromising future generations.
17 UN goals adopted 2015 to be achieved by 2030; replaced MDGs; integrated economic, social, environmental dimensions.
Kate Raworth's 2017 framework: social foundation inside, ecological ceiling outside; safe and just space between.
Shifting to low-carbon economy while protecting workers in fossil fuel industries; emphasised by ILO and EU Green Deal.
Gross National Happiness replacing GDP as policy metric; carbon-negative country; constitutional 60% forest cover.
German eco-district built 1996-2006; car-light, passive houses, solar PV; model sustainable community.
